awareness.name: Kumi Katayama
awareness.r0_detail:
When Katayama uses Discharge Sprocket, Secret Technique: Lightning Legs is unlocked and becomes usable 1 time.
When Secret Technique: Lightning Legs deals damage, greatly decrease the target's Down Points regardless of Electric affinity. Also, increase the Defense decrease effect of Hard Knocks by 10% for 2 turns (for every 10 points of Speed, increase by 2.22% more, up to a maximum bonus of 40%).
awareness.r1_detail:
When Katayama knocks down a foe, permanently decrease the target's Down Point maximum by 1.
When a target is inflicted with Detention, increase critical damage taken by 30% more for 1 turn.
When Katayama deals Electric damage, inflict Shock on the target.
awareness.r2_detail: When Katayama knocks down a foe with a skill, increase the target's damage taken while downed by 10% more for 1 turn. Also, permanently increase party's Attack by 10% (stacks up to 3 times).
awareness.r3_detail: Increase the skill levels of Discharge Sprocket and Thunderbolt Outrage by 3.
awareness.r4_detail: Highlight Enhanced: After activating a Highlight, the next time Katayama knocks down a foe, permanently increase the target's damage taken by 20% more. This effect does not stack.
awareness.r5_detail: Increase the skill levels of Secret Technique: Lightning Legs and Thief Tactics by 3.
awareness.r6_detail:
At the start of battle, gain 2 Wings of Guidance stacks. Gain 1 Wings of Guidance stack after every 2 skills used. Wings of Guidance stacks up to 3 times.
At the start of Katayama's turn, spend 1 Wings of Guidance stack to gain the following buffs for 1 turn. Increase Katayama's Attack by 50%, critical rate by 10%, critical damage by 30%, and allow her Highlight to activate critical hits. Also, increase damage taken by foes with Hard Knocks by 30% more, and increase damage taken by downed foes with Detention by 20% more.
When Katayama takes fatal damage, if she has Wings of Guidance, spend 1 Wings of Guidance stack to evade that damage (this effect activates once per battle, and is not effective against certain skills).

skill1.name: Discharge Sprocket
skill1.description:
Deal Electric damage to all foes equal to 101.7%/112.1%/108.0%/118.4% of Attack, and inflict Hard Knocks for 3 turns. When in Lightning Legs state, also increase this skill's damage by 35%.
Also, Secret Technique: Lightning Legs can be used 1 time.
Hard Knocks: Decrease Defense by 9.8%/10.8%/10.4%/11.4% (for every 10 points of Speed, increase by 2.22% more, up to a maximum of 39.0%/43.0%/41.4%/45.4%). Also, increase damage taken by 7.8%/8.6%/8.3%/9.1% (for every 10 points of Speed, increase by 1.78% more, up to a maximum of 31.2%/34.4%/33.2%/36.4%).

skill2.name: Thunderbolt Outrage
skill2.description:
Deal Electric damage to all foes equal to 135.5%/149.3%/143.8%/157.7% of Attack. Decrease Down Points of all targets that take damage by 1 regardless of Electric affinity, and inflict Hard Knocks for 1 turn. When in Lightning Legs state, decrease Down Points of all targets that take damage by 3 more and inflict Detention for 1 turn.
Hard Knocks: Decrease Defense by 9.8%/10.8%/10.4%/11.4% (for every 10 points of Katayama's Speed, increase by 2.22% more, up to a maximum of 39.0%/43.0%/41.4%/45.4%). Also, increase damage taken by 7.8%/8.6%/8.3%/9.1% (for every 10 points of Katayama's Speed, increase by 1.78% more, up to a maximum of 31.2%/34.4%/33.2%/36.4%).
Detention: Increase damage taken while knocked down by 0.56% for every 10 points of Katayama's Speed (up to a maximum of 9.8%/10.8%/10.4%/11.4%). Also, increase damage taken by 6.8%/7.5%/7.3%/8.0% (for every 10 points of Katayama's Speed, increase by 1.55% more, up to a maximum of 27.3%/30.1%/29.0%/31.8%).

skill3.name: Secret Technique: Lightning Legs
skill3.description:
Deal Electric damage to all foes equal to 141.9%/156.5%/150.6%/165.2% of Attack. When targets take damage, decrease Down Points by 5 regardless of Electric affinity, and inflict Detention for 1 turn.
When this skill knocks down any target, gain Lightning Legs for 2 turns.
Detention: Increase damage taken while knocked down by 0.56% for every 10 points of Katayama's Speed (up to a maximum of 9.8%/10.8%/10.4%/11.4%). Also, increase damage taken by 6.8%/7.5%/7.3%/8.0% (for every 10 points of Speed, increase by 1.55% more, up to a maximum of 27.3%/30.1%/29.0%/31.8%).
Lightning Legs: Enhance the skill effects of the next Discharge Sprocket or Thunderbolt Outrage used.

awareness.name: Ichigo Shikano
awareness.r0_detail:
The first time Ichigo activates Vorpal Butterfly, gain 1 Chains of Love stack. Also, each time she activates a Highlight, gain 1 Chains of Love stack. Chains of Love stacks up to 3 times.
Gain the following effects based on the number of Chains of Love stacks.
1: For each Lovesick stack inflicted, increase target's damage taken by 4%.
2: Increase critical rate by 15%. Also, all of Ichigo's skill damage is counted as continuous damage.
3: Increase continuous damage by 25%.
awareness.r1_detail:
For each Lovesick stack inflicted, decrease target's Defense by 3%.
Also, each time a skill is used, inflict 1 more Lovesick stack on the target.
awareness.r2_detail:
At the start of battle, gain 1 Chains of Love stack.
Chains of Love now stacks up to 5 times, and gain the following effects based on the number of stacks.
4: Increase critical damage by 36%.
5: The first time Ichigo takes fatal damage, survive with 1 HP and enter a special near-death state, and gain 4 Power of Love stacks. At the end each ally's turn, spend 1 Power of Love stack, and after all Power of Love stacks have been spent, Ichigo will be KO'd.
awareness.r3_detail: Increase the skill levels of My Beloved Prince and Thief Tactics by 3.
awareness.r4_detail: Highlight Enhanced: Each time her Highlight is activated, permanently increase Ichigo's Attack by 6%. Stacks up to 5 times.
awareness.r5_detail: Increase the skill levels of Vorpal Butterfly and Obsessive Rose by 3.
awareness.r6_detail:
Lovesick now stacks up to 15 times.
Based on the total number of Chains of Love stacks, the following effects can be activated. 
1: After activating Vorpal Butterfly, activate Vorpal Butterfly 1 more time on the selected target.
2: After activating Obsessive Rose, activate Obsessive Rose 1 more time on the selected target.
3: After activating My Beloved Prince, activate My Beloved Prince 1 more time on the selected target.
4: During Ichigo's turn, can activate Highlight 1 time on the selected target without spending the Highlight gauge (not affected by Highlight cooldown time).
(Each effect can activate only once during battle. If a target is defeated or the skill is nullified, reflected, or absorbed, a different target is selected for the skill effect.)

awareness.name: Wavecatcher Miyu
awareness.r0_detail:
Wavecatcher Miyu can enter Surf state, spending SP to automatically attack foes.
Increase Wavecatcher Miyu's max SP to 200, and at the start of battle, set her SP to 0. At the start of other allies' turns, restore 15 SP to Wavecatcher Miyu (affected by SP Recovery).
During battle, based on the total of her recovered SP (including SP above the maximum), gain the following effects.
100: Increase Attack by 25%.
200: Increase damage by 25%.
300: Increase critical rate by 12%.
400: Increase critical damage by 24%.
awareness.r1_detail:
Decrease SP cost of Catch a Wave by 40%, and increase max Offshore stacks by 2.
When entering Surf state, extend duration of all buffs/debuffs applied by 1 turn.
awareness.r2_detail:
While Surf is active, increase Wavecatcher Miyu's critical damage by 20%.
Every 4 times Catch a Wave is activated, activate a special Catch a Wave 1 more time without spending SP. This Catch a Wave does not count toward skill activation counts, and cannot grant Offshore stacks.
awareness.r3_detail: Increase the skill levels of Paddle Out and Thief Tactics by 3.
awareness.r4_detail: Highlight Enhanced: Increase Wavecatcher Miyu's Resonance damage by 30% for 2 turns.
awareness.r5_detail: Increase the skill levels of Jellyfish Splash and Aerial Tide by 3.
awareness.r6_detail:
Increase Wavecatcher Miyu's max SP by 250 more.
At the start of battle, recover max SP, and enter Surf state. Also increase max Offshore stacks by 2.
Additional effects are added to the following skills.
Jellyfish Splash: Increase SP recovered when used by 50%.
Aerial Tide: Surf state is not removed after using this skill, and Offshore stacks are lost after the turn ends. When stacks are lost, recover max SP.

When spending SP to activate a skill or Resonance, increase Wavecatcher Miyu's damage by 6.8%/8.8%/8.8%/10.8%/10.8%/12.8%/12.8%. This effect is permanent and stacks up to 5 times.

skill1.name: Jellyfish Splash
skill1.description:

skill2.name: Aerial Tide
skill2.description: Deal Ice damage to all foes equal to 178.7%/197.0%/189.7%/208.0% of Attack. When Surf is active, for each Offshore stack, increase this skill's damage by 10%. After activating this skill, remove Surf, and remove all Offshore stacks. This skill is counted as a Resonance.

skill3.name: Paddle Out
skill3.description:
Remove spiritual ailments from Wavecatcher Miyu, and enter Surf state. When this skill is used again while Surf is active, remove Surf and all Offshore stacks. On the turn when Surf is removed, other skills can be used, but Surf cannot be re-entered.
Surf: While this state is active, nullify Down, spiritual ailments, and certain unable to act effects, and Wavecatcher Miyu cannot use melee attacks, ranged attacks, or items. Also, extend the duration of buffs and debuffs applied by 1 turn. At the end of an ally's turn, if Wavecatcher Miyu has enough SP to activate Catch a Wave, automatically spend SP and activate Catch a Wave.
Catch a Wave: Spend 30 SP to deal Ice damage to all foes equal to 50.2%/55.3%/53.3%/58.4% of Attack, and gain 1 Offshore stack. For each Offshore stack, increase the skill damage of Catch a Wave by 5%, and increase the SP cost by 30. Stacks up to 4 times. Catch a Wave is counted as a Resonance, and cannot decrease foes' Down Points.

skill_highlight.name: Highlight
skill_highlight.description: Deal Ice damage to all foes equal to 329.4%/363.2%/349.7%/383.4% of Attack. When in Surf state, deal bonus Ice damage equal to 164.7%/181.6%/174.8%/191.7% of Attack 1 time.

passive1.name: Hang Ten!
passive1.description: During battle, increase Wavecatcher Miyu's Attack based on SP Recovery. At a maximum of 280.0% SP Recovery, increase Attack up to 98.0%.

passive2.name: Ride it Out!
passive2.description: When Surf is active, increase damage by 30.0%.

awareness.name: Beachflower Minami
awareness.r0_detail:
Beachflower Minami has 3 kinds of Everyday Medicine.
When using medicine on allies, restore HP to the main target equal to 8% of Beachflower Minami's max HP.
When using Gentle Sea Breeze, grant 1 Midsummer Prescription stack (stacks up to 1 time). At the start of Beachflower Minami's turn, she can spend 1 Midsummer Prescription stack to gain Flower Basket Pharmacy.
Flower Basket Pharmacy: Use medicine without spending a turn, and extend the duration of Potent Medicine used by 1 turn. After using medicine 1 time, lose this effect.
awareness.r1_detail:
When using Gentle Sea Breeze, gain 1 more Midsummer Prescription stack. Midsummer Prescription now stacks up to 2 times (only 1 Midsummer Prescription stack can be used in a turn).
Increase the effects of medicine used by Beachflower Minami by 20%.
awareness.r2_detail:
When using Beach Basket, inflict Perplexing Petals on the target.
Perplexing Petals: Decrease the target's Defense by 30%, and increase critical damage taken by 30% for 3 turns.
awareness.r3_detail: Increase the skill levels of Beach Basket and Gentle Sea Breeze by 3.
awareness.r4_detail: Highlight Enhanced: Extend the duration of all buffs granted by Highlight to 3 turns. Also, when using medicine, increase medicine effects by 5%.
awareness.r5_detail: Increase the skill levels of Summer Garden and Thief Tactics by 3.
awareness.r6_detail:
When using any medicine, items are not spent upon use.
Extend the duration of Potent Medicine effects by 1 turn. Also, when using medicine on allies with Flower Basket Pharmacy, also grant Summertime Refresh to the main target.
Summertime Refresh: Increase final damage amplification by 15% for 1 turn.

When using a skill on an ally, increase the main target's Attack by 10.0%/13.0%/13.0%/16.0%/16.0%/19.0%/19.0% for 2 turns.

skill1.name: Beach Basket
skill1.description:
Deal Bless damage to all foes equal to 64.4%/71.0%/68.4%/75.0% of Beachflower Minami's max HP, and inflict Bewitching Blossoms for 3 turns.
Bewitching Blossoms: When taking an attack, increase that damage's Attack by 9.8%/10.8%/10.4%/11.4% + 4% more for every 1200 of Beachflower Minami's max HP (up to 11712/12912/12432/13632 of max HP).

skill2.name: Summer Garden
skill2.description: Increase party's damage by 7.8%/8.6%/8.3%/9.1% + 3.2% more for every 1200 of Beachflower Minami's max HP (up to 11712/12912/12432/13632 of max HP) for 3 turns. Also, grant all allies 1 Blessing stack, and remove 1 debuff.

skill3.name: Gentle Sea Breeze
skill3.description:
Increase 1 other ally's critical rate by 15.6%/17.2%/16.6%/18.2%, and increase critical damage by 33.33% of the portion of Beachflower Minami's critical multiplier over 100% (up to 213.4%/229.9%/229.9%/246.4% of critical multiplier). Lasts for 3 turns.
Passive: When using medicine on an ally, increase the main target's critical damage for 1 turn. This increase is equal to 16.66% of the portion of Beachflower Minami's critical multiplier over 100% (up to 213.4%/229.9%/229.9%/246.4% of critical multiplier).

skill_highlight.description: Increase 1 other ally's damage by 24.4%/26.9%/25.9%/28.4%, and increase critical damage by 16.66% of the potion of Beachflower Minami's critical multiplier over 100% (up to 213.4%/229.9%/229.9%/246.4% of critical multiplier). Lasts for 2 turns. Also, when Beachflower Minami uses medicine, increase medicine effects by 9.8%/10.8%/10.4%/11.4%.

passive1.name: Soothing Sunlight
passive1.description:
Each time a skill is used on allies, grant 1 Blessing stack to targets.
When Beachflower Minami is present, for each Blessing stack on allies, increase their damage by 6.0% (up to 36.0%).

passive2.name: Blossoms by the Beach
passive2.description: When Beachflower Minami is present, increase allies' Attack by 12.0%, and for each type of buff granted by Potent Medicine, increase Attack by 15.0%.

awareness.name: Hatsune Miku
awareness.r0_detail:
During battle, Miku can change the battle scenery and song playing during her allies' turns, and her skill effects are enhanced based on the current song playing. When Miku's skills become available, the current song will automatically switch.
When using Feel the Beat or Clear Sound on songs where Miku has already gained the corresponding Track, reapply the same additional effect.

While Virtual Concert is active, increase Highlight and Theurgy Final Damage Amplification by 10%, and double the rate at which the Highlight and Theurgy gauges are filled.
awareness.r2_detail:
When Virtual Concert is activated, grant all effects of Feel the Beat and Clear Sound for 2 turns.
While Virtual Concert is active, increase party's Final Damage Amplification by 8%.
awareness.r3_detail: Increase the skill levels of Feel the Beat and Showstopper by 3.
awareness.r4_detail: When an ally activates a Highlight or Theurgy, increase that ally's Attack by 25% for 2 turns.
awareness.r5_detail: Increase the skill level of Clear Sound by 3.
awareness.r6_detail: When Virtual Concert ends, all foes take a fixed amount of Almighty damage equal to 100% of each target's total damage taken during Virtual Concert.

skill3.name: Showstopper
skill3.description:
Requires 3 different types of Track.
Spend all Tracks to activate Virtual Concert, and change the current song playing to Ghost Rule. At this time, stop foes' turn, and grant allies extra turns for 2 turns (these turns are not counted as extra actions and do not count towards the total number of actions taken, but reduce the countdowns of buffs, debuffs, and continuous damage effects).

At the start of battle, grant Mastermind to the ally with the highest Attack (prioritizing Sweepers or Assassins, select Akechi if no target found). At the start of each turn, can manually reselect a target to grant Mastermind. Only 1 ally can have Mastermind at one time (reselecting has a cooldown of 1 turn).
Also, increase Akechi's Attack by 25% of the Mastermind ally's Attack (up to a maximum of 500/750/1000, at level 1/50/70, respectively).
When an ally besides Akechi has Mastermind and deals damage to all foes with an attack skill, Highlight, Theurgy, or Resonance, record the average damage dealt to all foes (if targeting 1 foe, record 40% of the damage dealt). At the start of Akechi's turn, gain 1 Arrow of Truth stack based on the amount of damage recorded, and reset the recorded damage. Arrow of Truth can be held for 2 turns.
When Akechi has Mastermind, the effect of Rain of Justice changes, and Arrow of Truth deals Almighty damage based on the skill multiplier or Arrow of Perjury.
awareness.r1_detail:
At the start of battle, gain Deduction, and the durations of Deduction and Stratagem are extended to 4 turns.
Also, when Deduction and Stratagem are both active, increase Akechi's critical rate by 16%, and increase the damage dealt by Akechi and allies with Mastermind by 25%.
awareness.r2_detail: When dealing damage with a skill, if the attribute of the last skill used was different, increase the Attack of Akechi and allies with Mastermind by 25%, and their critical damage by 30%. Lasts for 1 turn.
awareness.r3_detail: Increase the skill levels of Rain of Justice and Thief Tactics by 3.
awareness.r4_detail: Highlight Enhanced: Increase the damage of Arrow of Perjury by 30% more for 4 turns.
awareness.r5_detail: Increase the skill levels of Flash of Intuition and Decisive Scheme by 3.
awareness.r6_detail:
When using Rain of Justice, increase the effect of Arrow of Truth by 50%.
Akechi and all allies are considered to have the Mastermind effect (the Attack increase from High School Detective is based on the ally with the highest Attack). During battle, increase Akechi's critical rate and critical damage more. This additional increase is equal to 40% of the critical rate of the Mastermind ally with the highest critical rate, and 40% of the highest critical multiplier exceeding 100% (up to a maximum of 20% and 40%, respectively).

weapon4-1.name: Victory Beam
weapon4-1.description:
Increase Almighty damage by 9.6%/9.6%/12.8%/12.8%/16.0%/16.0%/19.2%.
When gaining Suspicion, increase Attack by 22.0%/29.0%/29.0%/36.0%/36.0%/43.0%/43.0%.

weapon5-1.name: Gordian Kopis
weapon5-1.description:
Increase Attack by 30.0%/30.0%/39.0%/39.0%/48.0%/48.0%/57.0%.
When entering Deduction or Stratagem state, increase party's Attack by 21.0%/27.3%/27.3%/33.7%/33.7%/40.0%/40.0% for 2 turns.
Also, when an ally with Mastermind activates a skill, Highlight, Theurgy, or Resonance, increase Akechi's critical damage by 15.0%/19.5%/19.5%/24.0%/24.0%/28.5%/28.5% for 2 turns. Stacks up to 2 times.

weapon5-1.name: 신의 심판
weapon5-1.description: 공격력이 30.0%/30.0%/39.0%/39.0%/48.0%/48.0%/57.0% 증가한다. 자신이 『명확』 또는 『혼돈』 상태를 획득하면 2턴 동안 아군 전체 동료의 공격력이 21.0%/27.3%/27.3%/33.7%/33.7%/40.0%/40.0% 증가한다. 탐정 동료가 페르소나 스킬/HIGHLIGHT/테우르기아/추가 효과를 시전하면 2턴 동안 아케치 고로의 크리티컬 효과가 15.0%/19.5%/19.5%/24.0%/24.0%/28.5%/28.5% 증가한다(2회 중첩 가능).

skill1.name: Flash of Intuition
skill1.description:
Deal Bless damage to all foes equal to 93.2%/102.8%/98.9%/108.5% of Attack. Also, restore all allies' HP by 1561/1561/1657/1657 and grant 1 Blessing stack.
Also, gain Suspicion, and gain Deduction for 2 turns. With Deduction, increase party's damage by 19.5%/21.5%/20.7%/22.7%.

skill2.name: Decisive Scheme
skill2.description:
Deal Curse damage to all foes equal to 116.5%/128.5%/123.7%/135.6% of Attack.
Also, gain Suspicion, and gain Stratagem for 2 turns. With Stratagem, decrease all foes' Defense by 25.4%/28.0%/26.9%/29.5%. Also increase Arrow of Perjury's number of hits by 1, and increase damage dealt by 19.5%/21.5%/20.7%/22.7%.

skill3.name: Rain of Justice
skill3.description:
Usable with Suspicion.
Spend all Arrow of Truth stacks, deal a fixed amount of Almighty damage to all foes equal to 19.5%/21.5%/20.7%/22.7% of the damage recorded by each Arrow of Truth stack, and lose Suspicion.
Then, activate Arrow of Perjury on random foes, dealing Almighty damage equal to 77.4%/85.3%/82.2%/90.1% (4 hits). From the second hit, prioritize new targets, and decrease damage to 15% for hits on the same target.
If Akechi has Mastermind, Arrow of Truth gains 240% of the Almighty damage of Arrow of Perjury.

skill_highlight.description:
Deal Bless damage to all foes equal to 124.1%/136.9%/131.8%/144.5% of Attack, and Curse damage equal to 124.1%/136.9%/131.8%/144.5% of Attack (1 hit each).
Also, for 4 turns, increase Arrow of Perjury's number of hits by 2.

passive1.name: Rival's Pride
passive1.description: Can activate Flames of Desire effects with all allies in the party. At the start of battle, for each Flames of Desire effect activated, increase Akechi's damage by 15.0%.

passive2.name: Rending Arrow
passive2.description: When dealing Almighty damage, for every 1% of the target's decreased Defense, increase Akechi's damage dealt by 0.5% (up to a maximum of 120.0%).

awareness.name: Mayumi Hashimoto
awareness.r0_detail:
At the start of battle, Mayumi gains 90 Velocity stacks. At the end of each action by an ally, gain 4 Velocity stacks (if Mayumi's Speed is over 100, gain 1 more Velocity stack for every 10 points of Speed over 100; up to 6 stacks).
At the start of Mayumi's turn, if Velocity is over 120 stacks, can spend Velocity to gain an extra action at the end of her current action (cooldown: 1 turn). When total Velocity stacks gained during battle reach 100/220/350 stacks, activate level 1/2/3 of Torque Boost.
Torque Boost: Increase party's pierce rate by 5%/10%/15%.
awareness.r1_detail:
At the end of each action by an ally, gain 10 more Velocity stacks.
On an extra action, when using a skill different from the one used immediately before, activate the following additional effects.
Shockwave: When activating a skill, increase critical damage by 50%.
Aero Setup: Increase shield by 30%. Also, increase party's Defense by 30% more.
Power Setup: Increase main target's pierce rate by 10% more.
awareness.r2_detail:
When activating Torque Boost, activate the following additional effects.
Level 1: Increase party's critical damage by 20%.
Level 2: Increase party's damage by 20%.
Level 3: Increase party's Attack by 30%.
awareness.r3_detail: Increase the skill levels of Power Setup and Thief Tactics by 3.
awareness.r4_detail: Highlight Enhanced: Increase party's damage by 10% more. Also, extend the duration of the Highlight's buffs by 1 turn.
awareness.r5_detail: Increase the skill levels of Shockwave and Aero Setup by 3.
awareness.r6_detail:
The amount of Velocity stacks gained at the start of battle becomes 120. On Mayumi's extra action, spend 40 or 80 Velocity stacks, and activate the following additional effects the next time a skill is activated.
40 Velocity spent
Shockwave: When activating a skill, increase Mayumi's critical rate by 20%. If the target is knocked down, increase party's Attack by 25% for 2 turns.
Aero Setup: Increase shield by 20%. Also, extend the shield duration by 1 turn.
Power Setup: When used on an extra turn, change buff target from main target to all allies.
80 Velocity spent
Shockwave: Increase party's damage dealt to downed foes by 15% for 1 turn.
Aero Setup: Decrease party's damage taken by 20% for 1 turn.
Power Setup: Increase party's damage dealt by 25% for 1 turn.

weapon4-1.name: Formula Pennant
weapon4-1.description:
Increase Attack by 12.0%/12.0%/16.0%/16.0%/20.0%/20.0%/24.0%.
When activating Torque Boost, increase damage by 18.0%/23.4%/23.4%/28.8%/28.8%/34.2%/34.2%.

weapon5-1.name: Nebula Pennant
weapon5-1.description:
Increase Speed by 15/15/20/20/25/25/30. When Mayumi's Speed is over 100, for every 10 points of Speed above 100, increase Attack by 12.5%/16.2%/16.2%/20.0%/20.0%/23.8%/23.8% (up to a maximum of 100.0%/130.0%/130.0%/160.0%/160.0%/190.0%/190.0%).
After activating a skill, for every 40 stacks of total Velocity, increase party's damage by 3.4%/4.4%/4.4%/5.4%/5.4%/6.4%/6.4% for 2 turns (up to a maximum of 17.0%/22.0%/22.0%/27.0%/27.0%/32.0%/32.0%).

skill1.name: Shockwave
skill1.description:
Deal Physical damage to all foes equal to 134.2%/148.0%/142.5%/156.2% of Attack.
Also, increase party's damage by 8.8%/9.7%/9.3%/10.2% for 2 turns (for every 10 points of Speed, increase by 2% more, up to a maximum of 35.1%/38.7%/37.3%/40.9%).
When used on an extra action, increase skill damage by 50%, and activate a guaranteed critical hit on the main target.

skill2.name: Aero Setup
skill2.description:
Increase party's Attack by 8.8%/9.7%/9.3%/10.2% for 2 turns (for every 10 points of Speed, increase by 2% more, up to a maximum of 35.1%/38.7%/37.3%/40.9%). Also, increase party's Defense by 9.8%/10.8%/10.4%/11.4% for 2 turns (for every 10 points of Speed, increase by 2.22% more, up to a maximum of 39.0%/43.0%/41.4%/45.4%).
When used on an extra action, grant a shield to all allies equal to 2204/2354/2294/2444. This effect lasts for 2 turns.

skill3.name: Power Setup
skill3.description:
Increase party's pierce rate by 1.0%/1.1%/1.0%/1.1% for 2 turns (for every 10 points of Speed, increase by 0.22% more, up to a maximum of 3.9%/4.3%/4.1%/4.5%). Also, increase party's Attack by 12.7%/14.0%/13.5%/14.8% for 2 turns (for every 10 points of Speed, increase by 2.89% more, up to a maximum of 50.8%/56.0%/53.9%/59.1%).
When used on an extra action, also increase the main target's pierce rate by 2.0%/2.2%/2.1%/2.3% for 1 turn (for every 10 points of Speed, increase by 0.44% more, up to a maximum of 7.8%/8.6%/8.3%/9.1%).

skill_highlight.description: Increase party's Attack by 5.9%/6.5%/6.2%/6.8% for 2 turns (for every 10 points of Speed, increase by 1.33% more, up to a maximum of 23.4%/25.8%/24.9%/27.3%). Also, increase party's damage by 5.9%/6.5%/6.2%/6.8% for 2 turns (for every 10 points of Speed, increase by 1.33% more, up to a maximum of 23.4%/25.8%/24.9%/27.3%). Also, when the selected ally of this Highlight next deals direct damage to foes, decrease the selected foe's Down Points by 1 more.

passive1.name: Team Ambassador
passive1.description: When Mayumi is present, increase party's damage during extra actions by 45.0%.

passive2.name: Overtaking
passive2.description: When Mayumi is present, increase party's damage dealt to downed foes by 30.0%. Also, when Mayumi knocks down a foe, deal more Physical damage equal to 60.0% of Attack.

awareness.name: Kasumi Yoshizawa
awareness.r0_detail:
Kasumi's Highlight does not deplete the Highlight gauge, and can activate critical hits.
On an ally's action, with 2 or more Step stacks, can use Spellbound Cinders to enter Masquerade mode, and can activate Highlight 1 time (Spellbound Cinders has a cooldown time of 3 turns). This effect lasts until the start of Kasumi's second turn after entering Masquerade (or if Spellbound Cinders is used during her own turn, until the end of the following turn).
Also, for every Step stack gained while in Masquerade mode, increase Attack by 10% and critical rate by 4%.
When Masquerade ends, lose all Step stacks. If Masquerade ends and Highlight has not been used, activate Highlight on 1 random foe.
awareness.r1_detail:
Extend the duration of Dance Partner by 1 turn.
When using Invitation, increase critical rate of Kasumi and her Dance Partner by 15% for 3 turns.
awareness.r2_detail: With 2 Step stacks, increase Attack by 33%. With 3 or more stacks, increase critical damage by 33%. These effects are permanent.
awareness.r3_detail: Increase the skill levels of Cinderella Glow and Thief Tactics by 3.
awareness.r4_detail:
When activating a Highlight, gain 1 Stroke of Midnight stack. Spend 1 Stroke of Midnight stack when taking damage, and evade that damage (not activated by some skills).
Also, with 4 Step stacks, increase Highlight damage by 50%.
awareness.r5_detail: Increase the skill levels of Invitation and Midnight Magic by 3.
awareness.r6_detail: After Kasumi activates her Highlight, she can activate her Highlight 1 more time while in Masquerade mode. This Highlight has 80% of its normal damage, and can be activated 1 time each time Masquerade mode is entered. Also, it will not activate automatically when Masquerade mode ends.

weapon5-1.name: Royal Étoile
weapon5-1.description:
Increase critical damage by 36.3%/36.3%/47.2%/47.2%/58.1%/58.1%/69.0%.
When gaining a Step stack, increase Attack by 21.0%/27.0%/27.0%/33.0%/33.0%/39.0%/39.0% for 2 turns. This effect does not stack.
When an ally activates a Highlight or Theurgy, gain 1 Glass Slipper stack, and increase Kasumi's damage by 8.4%/11.1%/11.1%/13.8%/13.8%/16.5%/16.5% for 3 turns. Stacks up to 2 times.
When Glass Slipper is at 2 stacks, increase Kasumi's Highlight damage by 30.0%/39.0%/39.0%/48.0%/48.0%/57.0%/57.0% more.

weapon5-1.name: 황금빛 햇살
weapon5-1.description: 크리티컬 효과가 36.3%/36.3%/47.2%/47.2%/58.1%/58.1%/69.0% 증가한다. 자신이 춤사위를 획득할 때마다 2턴 동안 공격력이 21.0%/27.0%/27.0%/33.0%/33.0%/39.0%/39.0% 증가한다(1회 중첩 가능). 아군 괴도가 HIGHLIGHT/테우르기아를 사용하면 『소생』을 1중첩 획득하며 3턴 동안 자신이 주는 대미지가 8.4%/11.1%/11.1%/13.8%/13.8%/16.5%/16.5% 증가한다(2회 중첩 가능). 『소생』이 2중첩에 도달하면 자신이 주는 HIGHLIGHT 대미지가 추가로 30.0%/39.0%/39.0%/48.0%/48.0%/57.0%/57.0% 증가한다.

skill1.name: Cinderella Glow
skill1.description:
Deal Bless damage to 1 foe equal to 186.9%/206.1%/198.4%/217.5% of Attack, and gain Lead Step.
If this skill is activated by an ally with Dance Partner, deal Bless damage to 1 foe equal to 121.6%/134.1%/129.1%/141.5%, and gain 1 Lead Step.
Lead Step stacks up to 3 times.

skill2.name: Invitation
skill2.description:
Grant Dance Partner to 1 ally for 1 turn. Only 1 ally may have Dance Partner at one time.
Increase Attack of Kasumi and the selected ally by 32.4%/35.7%/34.4%/37.7% for 3 turns. Also, Kasumi gains Follow Step. This effect does not stack.
When an ally with Dance Partner uses a skill, immediately activate Cinderella Glow 1 time on 1 random foe (if the skill is activated on a foe, activate Cinderella Glow 1 time on that foe).

skill3.name: Midnight Magic
skill3.description:
Deal Bless damage to 1 foe equal to 249.1%/274.6%/264.4%/289.9% of Attack.
When using this skill while in Masquerade mode, increase skill damage by 30%, and critical damage by 29.3%/29.3%/31.1%/31.1%.

skill_highlight.description:
Can be activated in Masquerade mode. Deal Bless damage to 1 foe equal to 273.1%/301.0%/289.8%/317.8% of Attack. Also, with Step stacks, gain additional effects accordingly.
Lead Step: Increase Highlight damage by 15% for each stack.
Follow Step: Increase Highlight critical rate by 10%, and critical damage by 20%.

passive1.name: Rhythm Count
passive1.description: For every Step stack, increase Bless damage by 15% (up to 45.0%).

passive2.name: Steps of Faith
passive2.description: When an ally except Kasumi uses a Highlight or Theurgy, increase Kasumi's Attack by 45.0% for 2 turns. Stacks up to 2 times.

awareness.name: Firecracker Yaoling
awareness.r0_detail: Firecracker Yaoling's melee attack can evolve to Yanhua Slash. When evolved, deal heavy Fire damage to targets, and can activate Fire Technical. Also, when Fireburn is activated, the damage increase effect becomes 20%.
awareness.r1_detail:
Reduce the first cooldown time for Orange Blossom Blade by 1 turn. Also, extend the duration of Flaming Sword Dance by 1 turn, and Yanhua Slash can be activated up to 2 times. Also, when Flaming Sword Dance is active, enhance Scarlet Surprise and Firework Finale.
Scarlet Surprise: When enhanced, increase the critical damage of Yanhua Slash by 40% more.
Firework Finale: When enhanced, Yanhua Slash inflicts 1 more Year-End Flames stack.
awareness.r2_detail:
When Firecracker Yaoling is present, for each foe that appears, permanently inflict 1 special limit-breaking Burn stack. When this Burn is removed, 1 more stack is immediately inflicted. This effect's cooldown time is 2 turns, calculated individually for each foe.
During battle, when 1 foe is inflicted with Burn, increase Firecracker Yaoling's critical rate by 10%. Also, for each additional foe inflicted with Burn, increase by 3% more (up to a maximum of 16%).
awareness.r3_detail: Increase the skill levels of Firework Finale and Orange Blossom Blade by 3.
awareness.r4_detail: Highlight Enhanced: Increase Firecracker Yaoling's critical damage by 15% more for 2 turns. Also, extend the duration of all buffs gained from this Highlight by 2 turns.
awareness.r5_detail: Increase the skill levels of Scarlet Surprise and Thief Tactics by 3.
awareness.r6_detail:
Flaming Sword Dance becomes permanent. Yanhua Slash evolves to Liuxing Slash, increasing damage dealt by 80%. Flaming Sword Dance is not removed even after Liuxing Slash is activated.
Also, Scarlet Surprise permanently maintains the critical rate increase and enhanced effects on Liuxing Slash. The duration of Firework Finale's Burn and enhanced effects on Liuxing Slash are extended by 1 turn.

weapon5-1.name: New Year's Light
weapon5-1.description:
Increase Attack by 30.0%/30.0%/39.0%/39.0%/48.0%/48.0%/57.0%.
When Flaming Sword Dance is active, increase critical rate by 16.0%/21.0%/21.0%/26.0%/26.0%/31.0%/31.0%.
When a Fire Technical is activated, increase that damage by 34.0%/44.0%/44.0%/54.0%/54.0%/64.0%/64.0%.

skill1.name: Scarlet Surprise
skill1.description:
Deal Fire damage to all foes equal to 120.4%/132.8%/127.8%/140.2% of Attack, and increase Firecracker Yaoling's critical rate by 10% for 2 turns.
Also, for 1 turn, Yanhua Slash deals more Fire damage equal to 72.8%/80.3%/77.3%/84.7% of Attack.

skill2.name: Firework Finale
skill2.description:
Deal Fire damage to all foes equal to 73.8%/81.3%/78.3%/85.9% of Attack, with a 90% chance to inflict Burn, and a 90% chance to inflict 1 Year-End Flames stack for 2 turns.
Also, for 1 turn, Yanhua Slash has a 90% chance to inflict 1 Year-End Flames stack.
Year-End Flames: Take Fire damage equal to 63.4%/69.9%/67.3%/73.8% of Firecracker Yaoling's Attack for 2 turns. Stacks up to 4 times.

skill3.name: Orange Blossom Blade
skill3.description:
Gain Flaming Sword Dance: Increase damage by 34.3%/37.8%/36.4%/39.9%, and melee attack evolves to Yanhua Slash. After activating Yanhua Slash, or at the end of the turn, remove this effect.
This skill has a cooldown time of 1 turn, and after using it, other skills can be used on the same turn (this skill is not treated as a normal skill).
Yanhua Slash: Deal Fire damage to all foes equal to 127.4%/140.4%/135.2%/148.2% of Attack, and can activate Fire Technicals. When Fireburn is activated, the damage increase effect becomes 20%.

skill_highlight.description:
Deal Fire damage to all foes equal to 226.5%/249.7%/240.5%/263.7% of Attack.
Increase Firecracker Yaoling's Attack by 19.5%/21.5%/20.7%/22.7%, and damage dealt by Yanhua Slash by 19.5%/21.5%/20.7%/22.7% for 2 turns.

passive1.name: Prosperity in Red
passive1.description: Increase damage to foes inflicted with Burn by 36.0%.

passive2.name: Happy New Year!
passive2.description: At the start of battle, increase Attack by 42.0% for 2 turns. When Firecracker Yaoling or allies activate a Technical, this effect's duration is reset, and the increase effect becomes 51.0%.

awareness.name: Mio Natsukawa
awareness.r0_detail:
Some skills and Highlight can activate Ice Technicals. Also, when dealing Ice damage, ignore foes' Ice resistance.
On Natsukawa's action, gain 1 Extinguish stack. Stacks up to 4 times. When using Extinguishing Guidance, spend Extinguish stacks, and inflict 1 Damnation stack on all foes for each stack spent.
Damnation: Increase damage taken by 6% for 2 turns. Stacks up to 4 times.
awareness.r1_detail: When using Sub-Zero Torrent, gain 1 more Extinguish stack. When spending Extinguish stacks, increase all foes' critical damage taken by 30% for 2 turns.
awareness.r2_detail: When spending Extinguish stacks, increase party's Attack by 20%, Defense by 30%, and damage dealt by 15% for 2 turns.
awareness.r3_detail: Increase the skill levels of Extinguishing Guidance and Thief Tactics by 3.
awareness.r4_detail: Highlight Enhanced: Extend the duration of the damage taken increase effect by 1 turn. Also, when the Highlight activates Deepfreeze, the chance to inflict Icebound becomes 44%.
awareness.r5_detail: Increase the skill levels of Sub-Zero Torrent and Freezing Prison by 3.
awareness.r6_detail:
If foes have Burn or Scald on Natsukawa's action, activate Sub-Zero Torrent on that foe 1 time.
Also, when the same foe is attacked repeatedly with Extinguishing Guidance or Requiem Guidance, increase the target's damage taken by 25% more for 1 turn.
The maximum number of Damnation stacks becomes 6.

weapon4-1.name: Abyssal Thorn
weapon4-1.description:
Increase Attack by 12.0%/12.0%/16.0%/16.0%/20.0%/20.0%/24.0%.
For each Extinguish stack, increase ailment accuracy by 6.0%/7.8%/7.8%/9.6%/9.6%/11.4%/11.4%.

weapon5-1.name: Entropy
weapon5-1.description:
Increase ailment accuracy by 36.0%/36.0%/47.0%/47.0%/58.0%/58.0%/69.0%.
During battle, for every 66.0%/68.0%/68.0%/70.0%/70.0%/72.0%/72.0% of Natsukawa's ailment accuracy, increase Attack.
Also, each time an Ice Technical is activated, decrease the target's Defense by 23.3%/30.3%/30.3%/37.3%/37.3%/44.3%/44.3% more for 2 turns.

skill1.name: Sub-Zero Torrent
skill1.description:
Gain 1 Extinguish stack, and deal Ice damage to all foes equal to 97.6%/107.6%/103.6%/113.6% of Attack. 50% chance to inflict Freeze.
Also, decrease Defense by 7.8%/8.6%/8.3%/9.1% for 3 turns (for every 5.47% of Natsukawa's ailment accuracy, decrease Defense by 1% more, up to a maximum of 31.2%/34.4%/33.2%/36.4%). When an ally attacks a foe whose Defense has been decreased by this skill, increase Technical Precision by 195/195/207/207.
If at least 1 foe is inflicted with Burn, remove Burn and inflict Scald on all foes (cannot be inflicted if Scald is already active).
Scald: Counts as Burn. Lasts for 3 turns. When allies attack the affected foe, increase Technical Precision by 1186/1308/1259/1381.

skill2.name: Freezing Prison
skill2.description: Deal Ice damage to 1 foe equal to 195.2%/215.2%/207.2%/227.2% of Attack, and can activate an Ice Technical. When Deepfreeze is activated, 48.0%/52.9%/51.0%/55.9% chance to inflict Icebound.

skill3.name: Extinguishing Guidance
skill3.description:
Can be used at 2 or more Extinguish stacks. Spend 2 Extinguish stacks to deal Ice damage to all foes equal to 109.8%/121.0%/116.6%/127.8% of Attack. Also, decrease Defense by 7.3%/8.1%/7.8%/8.5% for 2 turns (for every 5.83% of Natsukawa's ailment accuracy, decrease Defense by 1% more, up to a maximum of 29.3%/32.3%/31.1%/34.1%).
Also, can activate Ice Technical. When Iceburn is activated, this effect is guaranteed to evolve to Cold Flames.
Cold Flames: Increase damage taken by 9.8%/10.8%/10.4%/11.4% (for every 4.38% of Natsukawa's ailment accuracy, increase damage taken by 1% more, up to a maximum of 39.0%/43.0%/41.4%/45.4%).
At 4 or more Extinguish stacks, evolve this skill to Requiem Guidance.

awareness.name: Frostgale Kotone
awareness.r0_detail:

For every 1 Spring's Vestige or Winter's Vestige stack she gains, permanently increase Attack by 5% (stacks up to 7 times).

Spring mode: Each time Spring's Edge is activated, gain 1 Spring's Vestige stack. When Spring's Edge ends, increase Resonance damage by 8% for each Spring's Vestige stack (up to 40%).
Winter mode: Each time Winter's Edge is activated, gain 1 Winter's Vestige stack. When Winter's Edge ends, increase Resonance damage by 8% for each Winter's Vestige stack (up to 40%).

Spring mode: While Spring's Edge is active, decrease all foes' Defense by 40%, and decrease party's SP costs for skills by 25%.
Winter mode: While Winter's Edge is active, increase party's Ice damage by 30%, and decrease SP costs for skills by 25%.
awareness.r3_detail: Increase the skill levels of Zephyr / Sapphire Storm and Ailes au Vent / Frozen Wings by 3.
awareness.r4_detail:

Winter mode: When activating a Highlight, if Winter's Edge is active, gain 1 more Winter's Vestige stack (this additional stack can exceed the maximum limit). If Winter's Edge is not active, increase Highlight damage by 35%.
awareness.r5_detail: Increase the skill levels of Éclat de Vent / Iceburst and Thief Tactics by 3.
awareness.r6_detail:

Regain up to 2 spent Spring's Vestige stacks, and regain up to 2 stacks that exceeded the maximum limit. Afterwards, the Resonance can be activated again (the duration cannot be extended again). Also increase Resonance pierce rate by 4% for each Spring's Vestige stack (up to 20%).

Regain up to 2 spent Winter's Vestige stacks, and regain up to 2 stacks that exceeded the maximum limit. Afterwards, the Resonance can be activated again (the duration cannot be extended again). When Two Masks as One is activated, increase Attack by 22.0%/29.0%/29.0%/36.0%/36.0%/43.0%/43.0% for 2 turns.

skill1.name: Mask of Mischief & Innocence
skill1.description:
Deal Fire damage to 1 foe equal to 74.5%/82.1%/79.0%/86.7% of Attack and Ice damage equal to 74.5%/82.1%/79.0%/86.7% of Attack (1 hit each; increase this effect by 1% for every 1 point of Desire Level). Also, increase party's Attack by 39.0%/43.0%/41.4%/45.4% for every 100 points of Desire Level for 3 turns.
Gain Facade of Mischief & Innocence.

skill2.name: Mask of Service & Admonition
skill2.description:
Deal Electric damage to 1 foe equal to 74.5%/82.1%/79.0%/86.7% of Attack and Wind damage equal to 74.5%/82.1%/79.0%/86.7% of Attack (1 hit each; increase this effect by 1% for every 1 point of Desire Level). Also, decrease party's damage taken by 9.8%/10.8%/10.4%/11.4% and 9.8%/10.8%/10.4%/11.4% more for every 100 points of Desire Level for 3 turns. Also, restore party's HP by 34.7%/38.3%/36.9%/40.4% of Justine & Caroline's Attack + 2225/2934/2735/3480.
Gain Facade of Service & Admonition.

skill3.name: Mask of Absurdity & Nonsense
skill3.description:
Deal Psychokinesis damage to 1 foe equal to 74.5%/82.1%/79.0%/86.7% of Attack and Nuclear damage equal to 74.5%/82.1%/79.0%/86.7% of Attack (1 hit each; increase this effect by 1% for every 1 point of Desire Level). Also, increase pierce rate for Justine & Caroline and the Sweeper or Assassin ally with the highest Attack by 4.9%/5.4%/5.2%/5.7% and 4.9%/5.4%/5.2%/5.7% more for every 100 points of Desire Level for 3 turns.
Gain Facade of Absurdity & Nonsense.

skill4.name: Mask of Luck & Loss
skill4.description:
Deal Bless damage to 1 foe equal to 74.5%/82.1%/79.0%/86.7% of Attack and Curse damage equal to 74.5%/82.1%/79.0%/86.7% of Attack (1 hit each; increase this effect by 1% for every point of Desire Level).
Also, increase Justine & Caroline's Attack by 14.6%/16.1%/15.5%/17.0% + 14.6%/16.1%/15.5%/17.0% for every 100 points of Desire Level, damage dealt by 9.8%/10.8%/10.4%/11.4% + 9.8%/10.8%/10.4%/11.4% for every 100 points of Desire Level, and critical rate by 4.9%/5.4%/5.2%/5.7% + 4.9%/5.4%/5.2%/5.7% for every 100 points of Desire Level for 3 turns.
Gain Facade of Luck & Loss.

skill5.name: Two Masks as One
skill5.description:
Usable when any 2 types of Facade have been gained. Deal Almighty damage to 1 foe equal to 126.9%/139.9%/134.7%/147.7% of Attack (increase this effect by 1% for every 1 point of Desire Level). Also, spend all Facades to activate the following effects based on their combination.
Facade of Mischief & Innocence + Facade of Service & Admonition: Restore party's HP equal to 52.2%/57.6%/55.4%/60.8% of Attack + 3344/4409/4111/5230. Also, increase party's damage dealt by 43.9%/48.4%/46.6%/51.1% for every 100 points of Desire Level for 2 turns.
Facade of Mischief & Innocence + Facade of Absurdity & Nonsense: Grant other allies 14.6%/16.1%/15.5%/17.0% of Skill Amplification for 2 turns. Also, increase party's critical damage by 19.5%/21.5%/20.7%/22.7% for every 100 points of Desire Level.
Skill Amplification: Increase the values of skills and Thief Tactics that are increased when leveled up. This effect is calculated separately from other effects.
Facade of Mischief & Innocence + Facade of Luck & Loss: Change this skill's target to all foes.
Facade of Service & Admonition + Facade of Absurdity & Nonsense: Grant all allies a shield equal to 41.8%/46.1%/44.3%/48.6% of Justine & Caroline's Attack + 2675/3527/3289/4184 and 1 Down Point for 2 turns. Also, increase party's Defense by 48.8%/53.8%/51.8%/56.8% for every 100 points of Desire Level.
Facade of Service & Admonition + Facade of Luck & Loss: Inflict Shock, Windswept and 2 Curse stacks on the main target, and gain 2 Blessing stacks. These effects last for 2 turns. Also, decrease all foes' Defense by 25.4%/28.0%/26.9%/29.5% + 25.4%/28.0%/26.9%/29.5% for every 100 point of Desire Level for 2 turns.
Facade of Absurdity & Nonsense + Facade of Luck & Loss: This skill deals 1 more hit of Almighty damage. Also, gain Rebel Surveillance for 2 turns.
Rebel Surveillance: When using a skill, temporarily gain 4.9%/5.4%/5.2%/5.7% of Effects stats from the Sweeper or Assassin ally with the highest Attack (excluding Justine & Caroline).

passive1.name: Overseer of Rehabilitation
passive1.description:
At the start of battle, increase Desire Level based on Justine & Caroline's base stats.
For every 100 points of Attack, increase Desire Level by 1 (up to 45).
For every 2% of Damage Mult. +, increase Desire Level by 1 (up to 15).
For every 6% of Critical Multiplier above 100%, increase Desire Level by 1 (up to 15).

passive2.name: Oxymoron
passive2.description:
Gain stat bonuses based on the selected Persona combinations:
Mask of Mischief & Innocence + Mask of Service & Admonition: Increase healing by 21.0%. Also, when on the field, increase party's damage dealt by 24.0%.
Mask of Mischief & Innocence + Mask of Absurdity & Nonsense: Increase Speed by 5. Also, when on the field, increase party's Attack by 30.0%.
Mask of Mischief & Innocence + Mask of Luck & Loss: Increase critical rate by 15.0%.
Mask of Service & Admonition + Mask of Absurdity & Nonsense: Increase Justine & Caroline's shield by 21.0%.
Mask of Service & Admonition + Mask of Luck & Loss: Increase Speed by 5. Also, when on the field, increase all foes' damage taken by 24.0%.
Mask of Absurdity & Nonsense + Mask of Luck & Loss: Increase critical damage by 30.0%.

skill_highlight.description:
When activating a Highlight, choose 1 of the 2 selected Persona sets and activate its Highlight below (cooldown times for each Highlight are calculated independently).
Mask of Mischief & Innocence: Increase the party's Attack by 24.4%/26.9%/25.9%/28.4% and damage by 34.2%/37.7%/36.3%/39.8% for 2 turns.
Mask of Service & Admonition: Restore the party's HP by 43.4%/47.9%/46.1%/50.6% of Justine & Caroline's Attack + 2782/3667/3419/4350.
Increase the party's max HP by 9.8%/10.8%/10.4%/11.4% for 2 turns.
Mask of Absurdity & Nonsense: Deal Psychokinesis damage to 1 foe equal to 244.0%/269.0%/259.0%/284.0% of Attack, and Nuclear damage equal to 244.0%/269.0%/259.0%/284.0% of Attack (1 hit each, can inflict critical damage).
Increase Attack by 34.2%/37.7%/36.3%/39.8% for Justine & Caroline and the ally with the highest Attack (prioritizing Assassins or Sweepers).
Mask of Luck & Loss: Deal Bless damage to all foes equal to 122.0%/134.5%/129.5%/142.0% of Attack, and deal Curse damage equal to 122.0%/134.5%/129.5%/142.0% of Attack (1 hit each, can inflict critical damage).
For 2 turns, increase Justine & Caroline's Attack by 29.3%/32.3%/31.1%/34.1% and critical damage by 19.5%/21.5%/20.7%/22.7%.

awareness.name: Haru Okumura
awareness.r0_detail:
For Haru's ranged attacks, deal Psychokinesis damage to all foes equal to 66% of Haru's Attack. When using certain skills, gain 1 corresponding Thoughtful Round stack and reload. Up to 3 stacks of Thoughtful Round with different effects can be stacked at the same time.
For each Thoughtful Round stack, grant unique effects to ranged attacks. When Haru uses a ranged attack, increase skill damage based on Thoughtful Round stacks (increase by 20%/40%/50% at 1/2/3 stacks, respectively). If at 2+ Thoughtful Round stacks, also increase Attack by 25%.
After using a ranged attack, remove all Thoughtful Round stacks.
awareness.r1_detail:
After a new foe appears, activate Extrasensory Aim for that foe at the start of Haru's next turn.
Based on Haru's Target Audience stacks, increase Attack by 8% (up to 24%) and ranged attack critical rate by 6% (up to 18%).
awareness.r2_detail: When Haru has 1+ Target Audience stacks, decrease damage taken by 25%. When at 3+ Target Audience stacks, increase Psychokinesis damage by 60%.
awareness.r3_detail: Increase the skill levels of Mindful Release and Thief Tactics by 3.
awareness.r4_detail: Overload Round Enhanced: When using a ranged attack, increase critical damage by 30%.
awareness.r5_detail: Increase the skill levels of Extrasensory Aim and Precise Volley by 3.
awareness.r6_detail:
When at 2+ Thoughtful Round stacks, evolve Haru's ranged attacks to Resonating Shots. Also, deal a ranged attack that activates all Thoughtful Round effects once. This additional attack's damage is 70% of the original attack.
At 2+ Thoughtful Round stacks, activate the following effects for Thoughtful Round gained from skills.
Focused Round: When using a ranged attack, also decrease the foe's ailment resistance by 27% for 2 turns.
Painpoint Round: When using a ranged attack and Haru has Target Audience, increase pierce rate by 12%.
Spillover Round: When using a ranged attack and Haru has Target Audience, increase critical rate by 20% and critical damage by 20%.

weapon5-1.name: Last Quarter
weapon5-1.description:
Increase ailment accuracy by 36.0%/36.0%/47.0%/47.0%/58.0%/58.0%/69.0%.
When dealing Psychokinesis damage, if Haru has Target Audience, increase Psychokinesis damage by 24.0%/31.0%/31.0%/38.0%/38.0%/45.0%/45.0%. Also, for each Thoughtful Round gained, increase Attack by 34.0%/43.0%/43.0%/52.0%/52.0%/61.0%/61.0% for 1 turn.

skill1.name: Extrasensory Aim
skill1.description:
Deal Psychokinesis damage to all foes equal to 75.8%/83.6%/80.5%/88.3% of Attack (2 hits). 97.6%/97.6%/103.6%/103.6% chance to inflict 1 Target Audience stack on the main target and 53.7%/53.7%/57.0%/57.0% chance to inflict 1 Target Audience stack on other foes. Then, transfer Target Audience stacks on foes to Haru and change Target Audience's duration to 3 turns. Also gain 1 Focused Round stack.
Focused Round: When using a ranged attack with Target Audience, increase skill damage by 29.3%/32.3%/31.1%/34.1%. After the ranged attack, remove all Target Audience stacks granted to Haru.

skill2.name: Precise Volley
skill2.description:
Deal Gun damage to 1 foe equal to 151.6%/167.1%/160.9%/176.4% of Attack. When Haru has Target Audience, increase this skill's pierce rate by 19.5%/19.5%/20.7%/20.7% and gain 1 Painpoint Round.
Painpoint Round: When using a ranged attack, also deal Psychokinesis damage to the main target equal to 39.0%/43.0%/41.4%/45.4% of Attack (can gain skill damage increases from Focused Round).

skill3.name: Mindful Release
skill3.description:
Deal Psychokinesis damage to all foes equal to 142.1%/156.7%/150.8%/165.4% of Attack. When Haru has Target Audience, increase this skill's critical rate by 19.5%/19.5%/20.7%/20.7% and gain 1 Spillover Round stack.
Spillover Round: When using a ranged attack, also deal Psychokinesis damage to all foes equal to 29.3%/32.3%/31.1%/34.1% of Attack (can gain skill damage increases from Focused Round).

skill_highlight.description:
Deal Psychokinesis damage to all foes equal to 206.9%/228.1%/219.6%/240.8% of Attack. Gain 1 Overload Round if Haru doesn't have any Overload Round stacks and is below maximum Thoughtful Round stacks.
Overload Round: When using a ranged attack, increase critical rate by 14.6%/14.6%/15.5%/15.5%.
If Haru hasn't gained any Overload Round stacks, increase this skill damage by 14.6%/16.1%/15.5%/17.0%.

passive1.name: Heiress's Leadership
passive1.description: During battle, increase Attack by 1% for every 1.45% of ailment accuracy (up to 165.0% of Attack). Also increase critical damage by 20% for every 50% of ailment accuracy (stacks up to 3 times).

passive2.name: Helping Others
passive2.description:
Permanently gain 1 Area to Improve stack for each Thoughtful Round stack gained. Gain the following effects based on the number of Area to Improve stacks.
1 stack: Increase ailment accuracy by 18.0% and ailment resistance by 18.0%.
2 stacks: Increase Attack by 18.0% and Defense by 18.0%.
3 stacks: Increase critical damage by 18.0%.

awareness.name: Cosmic Yui
awareness.r0_detail: Cosmic Yui can summon 4 types of Veggie Knights during battle, and can stack Veggie Energy. When Veggie Energy is stacked, Cosmic Yui can activate Veg-Out Attack. This skill's damage is counted as All-Out Attack damage. At the start of the turn, gain abilities based on Veggie Knights gained, and change the color of Cosmic Yui's Phantom Thief Attire. Eggplant Purple: When using a skill, gain 1 more stack of Veggie Energy. Potato Yellow: Increase Cosmic Yui's All-Out Attack damage by 15%. Mushroom Red: When dealing damage with a skill or All-Out Attack, 4.5% chance to inflict Brainwash on the target for 1 turn. Asparagus Green: When dealing damage with a skill or All-Out Attack, restore Cosmic Yui's HP by 1% of the damage dealt (up to a maximum of 1000 at once).
awareness.r1_detail: At the start of battle, Cosmic Yui immediately summons all 4 types of Veggie Knights and gains the maximum number of Veggie Energy stacks. For each Veggie Knight gained, increase Cosmic Yui's critical damage by 8% (up to 5 Veggie Knights). At the start of battle, Cosmic Yui changes to Potato Yellow state, and at the start of her first turn, automatically change to Eggplant Purple.
awareness.r2_detail:
Gain 1 more Potato Knight that will not be spent.
When activating the Resonance Harvest Havoc, increase Potato Power effects by 10% more.
At the start of battle, gain Potato Power for 2 turns.
awareness.r3_detail: Increase the skill levels of Veggie Knights, Go! and Veg-Out Attack by 3.
awareness.r4_detail: Highlight Enhanced: Increase Cosmic Yui's Attack by 35% for 4 turns.
awareness.r5_detail: Increase the skill levels of Harvest Fest and Thief Tactics by 3.
awareness.r6_detail: Unlock Prismatic state. Change Cosmic Yui's Phantom Thief Attire to Prismatic Color, and simultaneously gain abilities from Eggplant Purple, Potato Yellow, Mushroom Red, and Asparagus Green. At the start of battle, permanently enter Huge Harvest state, and change the following effects. When an ally ends their action, activate the Resonance Harvest Havoc. When using Veggie Knights, Go!, summon 1 more Potato Knight.

weapon4-1.name: Sprouting Voyagers
weapon4-1.description: Increase Attack by 12.0%/12.0%/16.0%/16.0%/20.0%/20.0%/24.0%. After activating a Resonance, increase Attack when using [Veg-Out Attack] by 22.0%/29.0%/29.0%/36.0%/36.0%/43.0%/43.0% for 2 turns.

weapon5-1.name: Starlight Decimators
weapon5-1.description:
Increase critical rate by 18.1%/18.1%/23.5%/23.5%/28.9%/28.9%/34.3%. When Veggie Knights are summoned, increase Cosmic Yui's Attack by 10.7%/13.8%/13.8%/16.9%/16.9%/20.0%/20.0%. This effect is permanent and stacks up to 4 times.
When using [Veg-Out Attack], increase critical damage by 32.8%/42.8%/42.8%/52.8%/52.8%/62.8%/62.8%.

skill1.name: Harvest Fest
skill1.description: Deal Nuclear damage to 1 foe equal to 120.8%/133.2%/128.3%/140.6% of Attack, gain 3 Veggie Energy stacks, and enter Huge Harvest state until the end of her next turn. If Potato Knight is present when this skill is used, automatically change to Potato Yellow at the end of the turn. Huge Harvest: At the end of Cosmic Yui's action, activate the Resonance Harvest Havoc, dealing Nuclear damage to 1 random foe equal to 93.5%/103.1%/99.2%/108.8% of Attack. Also, based on the current state, activate the following effects. Eggplant Purple: Gain 1 Veggie Energy. Potato Yellow: Gain Potato Power, and increase All-Out Attack damage by 14.6%/16.1%/15.5%/17.0% for 3 turns. Mushroom Red: Inflict Shroom Spores on the target, and increase damage taken by 19.5%/21.5%/20.7%/22.7% for 2 turns. Asparagus Green: Restore 976/1076/1036/1136 HP to the ally with the lowest remaining HP.

skill2.name: Veggie Knights, Go!
skill2.description:
Increase Cosmic Yui's Attack by 29.3%/32.3%/31.1%/34.1% and critical rate by 11.7%/12.9%/12.4%/13.6% for 2 turns, and summon 1 Veggie Knight according to a specific order.
After using this skill, other skills can be used on the same turn (this skill is not treated as a normal skill).
Passive: At the start of Cosmic Yui's action, automatically summon 1 Veggie Knight according to a specific order. Up to 1 Eggplant Knight, Mushroom Knight, or Asparagus Knight can be summoned each. Up to 4 Potato Knights can be summoned.

skill3.name: Veg-Out Attack
skill3.description: Deal Nuclear damage to 1 foe equal to 130.2%/143.5%/138.2%/151.5% of Attack, and for each Veggie Knight present, deal 1 more hit of Nuclear damage equal to 29.3%/32.3%/31.1%/34.1% of Attack. Also, if 2 or more Potato Knights are present, spend all but 1 Potato Knight, and for each Potato Knight spent, deal 1 more hit of Nuclear damage equal to 24.4%/26.9%/25.9%/28.4% of Attack. This skill's damage is counted as an All-Out Attack. When this skill is selected and used, gain 2 Veggie Energy stacks. If Eggplant Knight is present after activating this skill, automatically change to Eggplant Purple state at the end of the turn. Passive: At 7 Veggie Energy stacks, able to spend all Veggie Energy stacks to activate damage effect of Veg-Out Attack. Damage is distributed equally among all foes. This is not treated as normal skill damage.

skill_highlight.description: Deal Nuclear damage to 1 foe equal to 439.2%/484.2%/466.2%/511.2% of Attack. Also, according to specific rules, activate Harvest Havoc on the target.

passive1.name: Veggie Satellite
passive1.description: During battle, for each Veggie Knight gained, increase Cosmic Yui's damage by 8.1% (up to 4 Veggie Knights).

passive2.name: Mixed Vegetables
passive2.description: Increase All-Out Attack damage by 15.0%. When participating in an All-Out Attack, increase that damage more based on the total number of Veggie Knights Cosmic Yui has gained.
